text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Machikane Tannhauser has conquered the 2,400 meters!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...I did it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Y-Y-Y-Yayyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I took first place, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser?!
Seriously? You startled me...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe Mihono Bourbon lost!
And Rice Shower ran so well, too...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look over there!
Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower are—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! I couldn't reach them...!
I couldn't change, yet again...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is not true.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
She had leveled up several notches since the Satsuki Sho.
Marking her on the track made that abundantly clear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The biggest threat at the Kikuka Sho is surely you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bourbon-san...
Rice is... Rice is...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely take 1st place...!
I'll become a Rice you can be proud of...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm pretty sure I saw it mentioned
in an online article I skimmed the other day!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I read that!
About how Mihono Bourbon has her eye on her.
I thought it was just exaggerated writing, but—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, to think it was actually true...!
Now I'm seriously looking forward to the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as much applause as was directed at Machikane Tannhauser
enveloped the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Look, "Mihono Bourbon" and "Rice Shower"
are trending!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Machitan won, sure, but...
Man. Isn't that a bit rude?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, I really hope things don't get messy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now that you mention it,
I feel like more people in the crowd
were clapping for Bourbon and the others?
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no!
I was just thinking, 'Yeah, that's really how it was~'!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's Rice-san and Bourbon-san, after all—they're the hot topic right now. It's only natural everyone's looking over there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Besides, winning is what matters! In that sense, you get full marks with a gold star!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Trainer, wanna take a photo together?
I really want to post one on social media!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Actually, using the "#DerbyVictory" tag
has always been a dream of mine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"—'I won the Japanese Derby!
I gave it everything I had, so it really feels like a dream!
I'll do my best in the Kikuka Sho too! (Elephant emoji)'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer.
What do you think? Is this good?
Should I throw in a joke or something?"
choice_data_list: I think that's a great comment.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Awesome!
Alright then, hitting send~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that's one job done!
It really is like cleaning up after a dream—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...I forgot to add the tags...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, the Nippon Derby thus
came to a close with a magnificent result.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mm?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, well... it's about the comments on that
Japanese Derby post from the other day...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "‘Indeed, in a contest, there is only victory and defeat. I want to learn from that attitude!’"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"As long as she isn't bothered by
the media spotlight, those around her
have no business making a fuss."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so everyone's like this, huh.
Uh, what are we talking about again? Something about attention...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, after the Japan Derby, other Umamusume received more attention than the winner herself, sparking heated arguments among the fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Matikanetannhauser didn't care in the slightest,
expressing her joy in her usual, ordinary way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when that honest attitude earned
high praise online, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be...
a job for the secret art of vanity searching!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems he truly had no idea,
from beginning to end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Does it really never cross your mind
that you might end up at the center of an incident?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All in all... the Kikuka Sho is next.
As always, I have no intention of losing.
